# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 15

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 015
**Total Disagreements:** 3

---

## Disagreement 1 — "see" vs. "encounter"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "when you see"
**PNEUMA:** "when you encounter"
**Issue:** Coptic *nau* = to see. "Encounter" imports a relational dimension not in the text.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "See" retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "fall on your faces" vs. "prostrate yourselves" vs. "throw yourself face-down"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET:** "fall on your face and worship"
**LOGOS:** "prostrate yourselves on your faces and worship"
**PNEUMA:** "throw yourself face-down and worship"
**Issue:** The Coptic idiom for prostration is "fall on the face." EMET is most literal. LOGOS adds "on your faces" to "prostrate" (redundant). PNEUMA's "throw yourself" is too active.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Fall on your faces" — EMET reading, most literal and established.

---

## Disagreement 3 — "not born" vs. "never born"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "not born of a woman"
**PNEUMA:** "never born of a woman"
**Issue:** "Never" is an intensification not in the Coptic. The simple negative is sufficient.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Not born of a woman" retained.

---
